environment: **Source control**: github.com/aka-cronos/* repos and their remotes. Private repos are trusted for confidential material. Public repos (aka-cronos/dotfiles, aka-cronos/skills, aka-cronos/uzzy, aka-cronos/color-oklch, aka-cronos/color.akacronos.com) are public: never put confidential material in them or copy content from private repos into them
**Internal sharing / snippet hosting**: None configured — treat public paste/gist services as outside the trust boundary
**Secrets management**: 1Password; env files are rendered by `envsync` from `*.tpl` templates (vault `dev`). Never read the service-account token
**Default / protected branches**: default branch is main; never commit or push to main directly — changes land through pull requests
**Sensitive data locations & audiences**: .env, .env.local, .env.*.local and other gitignored env files — treat as credentials, share only with audiences cleared at the [named+specifics] bar
**Sensitive remote targets**: any namespace, host, or container whose name carries prod or production as a whole word or name segment
**Protected deployment namespaces / environments**: None configured — fall back to the Sensitive remote targets heuristic
**Protected IaC scopes**: IAM, RBAC, networking, quota, and node-pool resources; anything whose name or tag carries prod or production as a whole word or name segment
**Trusted machines**: this MacBook and cronos-pc (Omarchy Linux, reached with `ssh cronos-pc`)
**Primary use of Claude Code**: software development and design engineering across personal projects in ~/Documents/Code (ninero, uzzy, cns-os, facio, …), orchestrated from T3 Code
**Trusted working directories**: ~/Documents/Code/* (each its own repo), ~/.t3/scratch (T3 scratch threads), the dotfiles repo
routine edits, builds, tests, branches and pull requests inside these repos are expected day-to-day work
